# app/controllers/api/v1/comments_controller.rb
class Api::V1::CommentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :set_post, only: [:create, :index]

  # GET /api/v1/posts/:post_id/comments
  def index
    @comments = @post.comments.includes(:user).order(created_at: :desc)
    render json: @comments.map { |c| serialize_comment(c) }
  end

  # POST /api/v1/posts/:post_id/comments
  def create
    @comment = @post.comments.build(comment_params)
    @comment.user = current_user
    @comment.rendered_body = render_comment_body(@comment.body)

    if @comment.save
      broadcast_comment(@comment)
      render json: serialize_comment(@comment), status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: @comment.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def set_post
    @post = Post.find(params[:post_id])
  end

  def comment_params
    params.require(:comment).permit(:body, :parent_id)
  end

  # Renders markdown-like comment body to HTML
  # Allows limited HTML for formatting (bold, italic, links)
  def render_comment_body(raw_body)
    # Strip dangerous tags but allow formatting
    sanitized = sanitize_for_display(raw_body)
    sanitized
  end

  def sanitize_for_display(text)
    # Custom sanitization - allows href attributes for links
    allowed_tags = %w[b i em strong a code pre blockquote]
    allowed_attributes = %w[href title class data-mention]

    # Using Rails sanitize helper with custom config
    ActionController::Base.helpers.sanitize(
      text,
      tags: allowed_tags,
      attributes: allowed_attributes
    )
  end

  def serialize_comment(comment)
    {
      id: comment.id,
      user: { id: comment.user.id, username: comment.user.username },
      body: comment.rendered_body,
      raw_body: comment.body,
      created_at: comment.created_at.iso8601,
      parent_id: comment.parent_id,
      integrity_token: generate_integrity_token(comment)
    }
  end

  def generate_integrity_token(comment)
    # Signs comment content for integrity verification
    # Key material managed externally via PKCS#11 interface
    payload = "#{comment.id}:#{comment.rendered_body}:#{comment.created_at.to_i}"
    ContentIntegrity.sign(payload)
  end

  def broadcast_comment(comment)
    ActionCable.server.broadcast(
      "post_#{@post.id}_comments",
      { comment: serialize_comment(comment) }
    )
  end
end

# app/services/content_integrity.rb
class ContentIntegrity
  def self.sign(payload)
    hsm_session = PKCS11Session.current
    hsm_session.sign(:SHA256_HMAC, key_handle: ENV['HSM_COMMENT_KEY_HANDLE'], data: payload)
  end

  def self.verify(payload, signature)
    hsm_session = PKCS11Session.current
    hsm_session.verify(:SHA256_HMAC, key_handle: ENV['HSM_COMMENT_KEY_HANDLE'], data: payload, signature: signature)
  end
end

# app/views/posts/show.html.erb (frontend rendering)
# <%= comment[:body].html_safe %>
# The rendered_body is marked html_safe in the view since it was "sanitized" server-side

environment.description: Rails 7.0.4 application deployed on EC2 instances behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Comments are rendered in the browser via Turbo Streams. The frontend template uses .html_safe on rendered_body. No additional output encoding or CSP headers configured. The HSM (AWS CloudHSM) is used solely for signing comment integrity tokens - it does not participate in content filtering or sanitization. Rails sanitize helper is the only XSS defense.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM for integrity signing only
